newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers Tuesday peak firm power, drops prices.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers Tuesday peak firm power, drops prices.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 300 megawatts of peak firm power for Tuesday delivery, but cut prices sharply, the agency said Monday.

BPA offered peak firm power during heavy load hours on Tuesday at $19.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), down from $31.00 for Monday deliveries, and at $20.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, compared with $32.00 for Monday.
BPA also offered unlimited peak firm power during light load hours on Tuesday at $9.00 a MWh.
Tuesday non-firm power from hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was also offered at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.
